isolated_component_assets.runtime_rule: Load the isolated component PNG as a whole texture. The source region below is provenance and fallback review data only.
isolated_component_assets.source_separation: Touching plates use explicit source-coordinate alpha partitions; separated plates use connected islands plus nearest-main-island assignment. No pixels are redrawn.

composition_rules.blessing_topology_owner: inherit base series anchors and paths
composition_rules.contact_composition: Layer only the listed local component crops at the contact anchor.
composition_rules.path_composition: Repeat a listed travel crop with stagger and overlap; never expose another plate cell.
composition_rules.alpha_bounds_policy: native_alpha_bounds is the non-zero-alpha bbox [left, top, right, bottom]; component regions are source-provenance rectangles [x, y, width, height], while isolated component PNGs are the safe runtime textures.
composition_rules.tint_policy: Base tint defaults to #FFFFFF (preserve authored palette); Blessings are additive accents, not full recolors.
